reviewer.effort: image adjudication followup on two frozen readings, using only the supplied page JPGs, bands and enlarged crops. I could not make new zoomed crops.

decisions.evidence: Band1, line 1, right of centre. Under the shin there is a qamatz. I may see a small vertical tick beside it, but at this resolution I can't tell a meteg apart from the qamatz's own stem or from the shin's dagesh/shin-dot area. Neither reading can be confirmed from the pixels.

Band1, line 1, far left. The maqaf between פן and יפתה is clearly printed. Under פֶּ there is a segol. I can't confirm a separate merkha stroke beside it at this resolution, nor rule one out. The tipcha under תֶּ is consistent with both readings.

vechara112-full.png: (1) The accent on וחרה is a single short slanted stroke over the interior resh. It is not a looped telisha on the word-final he, so it supports qadma on רָ. (2) Over יהוה there is a curved slanted stroke, which fits geresh better than a second qadma. (3) Over בכם the mark is a dot/rhomb above the kaf, which is revia. It is not a geresh stroke. The cantillation sequence qadma–geresh–revia matches ours in all three words. Note: the crop also shows a holam dot over the vav of the Divine Name here (יְהֹוָה-type pointing). This was not part of the difference, and neither reading changes it.

Band1, line 7. The patah under ע and the maqaf are visible. I see no clear separate vertical meteg tick next to the patah, but the band resolution isn't enough to rule out a thin one. I lean toward ours (no meteg), but not strongly enough to decide.

Band2, line 1, right edge. The word starts with shuruk vav. There may be a mark beside the vav at the baseline, but I can't separate it from the sheva under the bet that follows. A meteg on the vav is neither confirmed nor excluded.

Page and band2 line 2. At the line end, עַל is followed by a clearly printed raised maqaf, 'עַל־', at the left margin. On the next line (band2 line 3), under the he of האדמה there is a qamatz, then a distinct vertical stroke, then the hataf patah under the aleph. That pattern means a meteg on הָ. The yetiv under ע is in both readings. The maqaf is high confidence. The meteg is medium.

Band2, line 8, right edge. Under the first nun there is a qamatz with a small stroke beside it. That could be a merkha (ours) or a meteg. Under the second nun there is a small mark that could be a tevir or just a sheva-like blot. At this resolution I can't tell whether the cantillation sits on the first or the second nun.

Page and band2, last line, right side. There is a clear space between ולא and תתורו with no raised maqaf. Compare the clearly printed maqafs elsewhere on the page (את־כל, על־ציצת). Keep the source as printed. This may be a source variant.
Band3, last line. After וָעֶד, before אֱמֶת, there is a sof-pasuq-style colon with two vertically stacked dots. It is not a single period.

s113 band2, last line: 'after which you go astray' ends with blank space and no period. The next line starts with 'Thus'. Preserve the source literally, and if wanted record the missing period as a sic/corr. Don't silently add it.

remaining_uncertainties.word: entire rubric (יש לגרף אלהיכם לאמת, אכן יתן ריוח/רוח בנתיים שלא יבולע הא׳.)
remaining_uncertainties.evidence: This was already sent to the human. rubric112-full.png shows Rashi script ending in a geresh mark after הא and a period. I haven't settled the wording, including רוח vs ריוח and אכן vs אבל.
Band1, line 5. A dot inside the final he can't be distinguished at this resolution. Don't add one from memory.
Band2, citation line. The lamed's interior isn't resolvable.
Small marginal text split across two lines. Marks are visible but I can't identify the form (gershayim vs two gereshes).
Band2, line 9. There is a dot above, near the vav/tav junction. I can't tell holam haser for vav (U+05BA) apart from regular holam on the vav.
Band3. Not resolvable at this resolution.
Only the differences listed in the decisions were adjudicated. The other accents stay as low-confidence readings in both versions.

notes: Verdict labels: 'primary' = ours is correct; 'independent' = theirs is correct.

Source spellings checked against pixels and confirmed as printed: לְטוֹטָפֹת has a vav after the first tet and none after the pe (band1 line 8). מְזוּזוֹת is plene (band2 line 1). צִיצִת is defective (band2 lines 7–8). Keep them as printed.
Under the shared uncertainty for vehaya_deut_11_21: the maqaf after עַל at the line end is visible. That is folded into the עַל־הָֽאֲדָמָה decision.

Five Hebrew differences are left unresolved because band resolution can't separate meteg or conjunctive-accent ticks from nearby vowel strokes. Crops at 4x or more of the specific words would probably settle them.

No 'Thou', 'Praiscs' or 'has created' items, no parenthetical מלכנו, and no Shabbat rubrics appear on s112/s113. The other three pending-human questions (MiKhamokha116, זכרוננו/ופקדננו120, Jerusalem124) are outside these scans and were not touched.
